#!/bin/bash

BASE_DIR="/private/var/folders/_q/qzh8_t6s15388qqf3p6n3d200000gp/T/bench-jzd6tqw2/src"

echo "=== DETAILED ERROR HANDLING BY FILE ==="
echo ""

for rs_file in $(find "$BASE_DIR" -name "*.rs" | sort); do
  # Get just the relative path from src
  rel_path=${rs_file#$BASE_DIR/}
  
  # Check if file uses anyhow::Result or BivvyError
  uses_anyhow=$(grep -l "anyhow::Result\|use anyhow" "$rs_file" 2>/dev/null)
  uses_bivvy=$(grep -l "BivvyError\|use crate::error" "$rs_file" 2>/dev/null)
  
  if [ -n "$uses_anyhow" ] || [ -n "$uses_bivvy" ]; then
    echo "FILE: $rel_path"
    
    # Show imports
    grep -H "^use.*Result\|^use.*error\|^use anyhow" "$rs_file" | sed 's|.*:||g' | sed 's/^/  /'
    
    # Count function definitions with Result
    func_count=$(grep "fn.*-> Result\|fn.*-> anyhow::Result" "$rs_file" | wc -l)
    if [ "$func_count" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "  Functions returning Result: $func_count"
    fi
    
    # Look for map_err and context
    map_err=$(grep -c "\.map_err" "$rs_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    context=$(grep -c "\.context" "$rs_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$map_err" -gt 0 ] || [ "$context" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "  Error conversions: map_err=$map_err, .context=$context"
    fi
    
    echo ""
  fi
done | head -150
EOF
